page.overview:
Who is Domidak?

When approaches them, he will find that the two of them are busy discussing a bandit by the name of and the location of their supposed treasure. However, will quiet his brother when he notices standing there. As explains who they are, immediately chides him for giving out information. is quick to dismiss Link and any attempt at conversation. He then mutters to himself that he is grateful for the lack of rivals.

If is persistent, will give up his attempts to pass off 's slip as rambling. When suggests telling the riddle they found to get him to leave, agrees. Domidak explains that they are seeking the treasure of , a legendary bandit. However, Domidak refuses to tell more without proper compensation and requires 100 , though he claims the price for the exclusive information is a steal. If Link agrees, but does not have enough Rupees, Domidak will scoff and turn him away.

Once agrees to the deal and gives up the required, will tell him the riddle they discovered. He explains where he got this information from and claims it is unmistakable. At the end of the conversation, the "" begins. can still talk to the pair to overhear musing over the riddle. If tells them to keep at it will snap at him, causing to tell his brother to quiet down and let him think.
